what_happened: The owner rejected the decisions page as unusable ("garbo"). It listed three proposals as waiting for the owner, but all three were already decided or were not the owner's to decide. Each card began with file paths instead of the question being asked, so the owner could not tell what they were deciding. A fix was queued to list only open proposals, and a rewrite of the cards as yes/no questions was queued too.
cause: The page is built from stored proposal records without a code filter on their current status or on who owns the decision. Nothing defines what an owner-facing card must contain (a question, options, a consequence) or checks the output against that. Nothing tests the rendered page with real queue data before the owner sees it. Athena therefore never learns the page is wrong until the owner reads it and complains.
prevention: Add a code check that runs when the decisions page is generated. It must (1) list a proposal only if its recorded state is open and its decider is the owner, and fail generation if a listed item has a decision record or another decider. (2) Require each card to start with a yes/no question line, with file paths only in a later detail section, and fail if the first line is a path. Add a test that renders the page from a fixture of real past proposals, mixing open, decided and not-owner items, and asserts that only the open owner items appear, each led by a question.
proposed_request: Fix the owner decisions page so the owner can see at a glance what they are deciding. Outcome: the page lists only proposals that are still open and that the owner is the one to decide; proposals already decided, or decided by another role, never appear. Each card opens with one plain yes/no question stating the decision and what happens on yes and on no; file paths and other detail go in a collapsed or later section. Acceptance: (1) a code check at page generation fails if any listed proposal has a decision record or a non-owner decider. (2) A code check fails if a card's first line is not a question. (3) A test builds the page from a fixture copied from real past proposals (open, already decided, not the owner's) and asserts that only the open owner proposals appear, each led by its question. (4) Regenerating the page against the current records shows no card for the three proposals the owner flagged. Deliverables are limited to the page generator, its check, and its tests.
